items.title: 12.11 Zarron ke masses ke darmiyan forces ke nazariyat (Roman Urdu)

source_refs.note: Roman Urdu explanation of topic 12.11 (PDF 275-276) in the book's order, with a tip and a self-check.

blocks.text: Zarron ke masses ke darmiyan mukhtalif darmiyani zarron (mediators) ke zariye asar samjhane ke liye do theories hain: quantum field theory aur string theory.
1. Quantum field theory (kitab mein dono theories par '2.' chhapa hai)

Is theory ke mutabiq har zarre ko ek field se zahir kiya jata hai jise quantum field kehte hain; yahi field ek mediator ke zariye ek zarre se doosre tak force pohanchati hai. Maslan ek positive charged zarra apne gird electric field banata hai, aur isi field ke zariye qareeb ke negative charged zarre ko khainchta hai. Field ek zarre se doosre tak energy aur momentum bhi le ja sakti hai. Tamam fields ki energy aur momentum quantized hai, yani chhote chhote pakkat (packets) mein. Jo quanta (packets) field mein ek zarre se doosre tak energy aur momentum pohanchate hain, unhein field particles kehte hain. Is tarah zarron ka aapas ka asar field particles (quanta) ke len-den se samjhaya jata hai, aur yeh sab bosons hain. Electromagnetic force photons se (electromagnetic field ke quanta), strong nuclear force gluons se, weak force W aur Z bosons se, aur gravity gravitons se pohanchti hai.

blocks.alt: Paanch tasveeron ki amoodi zanjeer jo kham-dar teeron se juri hai: molecule (10⁻⁹ m), atom jis ke chhote markazi nucleus ke gird electrons ke madar (orbits) hain (10⁻¹⁰ m), nucleus nucleons ka guchha (10⁻¹⁴ se 10⁻¹⁵ m), neutron ya proton (10⁻¹⁵ m), aur quark (10⁻¹⁸ m se kam).
blocks.caption: Maadde ka paimana, molecule se quark tak (For Your Information; kitab mein topic 12.11 ke saath bani be-unwan tasveer ke mutabiq asal khaaka).

blocks.title: Diagram ko samjhein
blocks.text: Har teer ke saath hum maadde ke andar ek satah neeche jate hain: molecule atoms se, atom nucleus aur electrons se, nucleus neutrons aur protons se, aur neutron ya proton quarks se bana hai. Size dekhein: 10⁻¹⁰ m ka atom 10⁻¹⁵ m ke proton se taqreeban ek lakh (10⁵) guna bara hai. Quark ka size 10⁻¹⁸ m se bhi kam hai.

String theory theoretical physics ka ek advanced khayal hai jis ke mutabiq kaainat ke bunyadi zarre nuqte (points) nahi balke nanhe larazte (vibrating) dhaage (strings) hain. Yeh strings khule ya band chhalle (loops) ho sakte hain, aur in ki larzish (vibration) ka andaaz zarre ki khususiyat, jaise mass aur force, tay karta hai. String theory 'theory of everything' (har cheez ki ek theory) ban sakti hai, magar tajurbe se abhi tak sabit nahi hui.

blocks.prompt: Quantum field theory aur string theory ka mukhtasar muwazna kijiye.
blocks.explanation: Quantum field theory har zarre ko kisi field ka quantum samajhti hai aur forces ko boson field particles (photons, gluons, W aur Z, gravitons) ke tabadle se bayan karti hai; yeh Standard Model ki bunyad hai aur achi tarah parkhi gayi hai. String theory nuqta-numa zarron ki jagah nanhe larazte khule ya band strings rakhti hai jin ki larzish ke andaaz zarron ke masses aur forces dete hain; yeh gravity samet 'theory of everything' banna chahti hai magar tajrube se tasdeeq nahi hui.

items: Quantum field theory: har zarre ki quantum field; forces field quanta ke len-den se, sab bosons: photons (electromagnetic), gluons (strong), W aur Z (weak), gravitons (gravity).

String theory: zarre nanhe larazte khule ya band strings, jin ki larzish mass aur force tay karti hai; 'theory of everything' ka umeedwar, abhi sabit nahi. Paimana: molecule 10⁻⁹ m se quark 10⁻¹⁸ m se kam tak.
